[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Explicit session/turn targets for fork and agent waits[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`#fork:<name>` reliably waits for the whole agent session, even [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]when the parent is promoted into a session after the fork launched.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Users can explicitly choose `session` or `turn` with `#fork(<name>,[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]target=session|turn)`, `%wait(<name>, target=session|turn)`, `sase [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]agent wait -T`, and the plan-gate coder options. Admission and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]injected fork history agree on the same bound target.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
